verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shopify POS has a developer API reference for POS UI extensions (shopify.dev/docs/api/pos-ui-extensions), including CLI scaffolding and named APIs like shopify.storage and shopify.toast. Nothing in the pack describes an interactive explorer or runnable, in-browser examples. A static API reference is adjacent to this story's interactive, runnable capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
